meta.title: Kisumu County: Auditor-General opinions by entity and year (data layer; not yet on pages)
meta.rule: Opinions are the auditor's findings about financial statements, not legal conclusions and not verdicts on any person. No individuals are named; offices and entities only. Each separately audited entity keeps its own opinion: the County Revenue Fund, the Receiver of Revenue and the water company are never merged into "the county". An opinion from a secondary summary carries tier "secondary". Every opinion read from a machine OCR layer is flagged needs_page_check: a person must confirm it against the page image before review.
